ddl.value: "quarantined" OR ("entity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "seller_id" IS NOT NULL AND "buyer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "currency" = 'eur' AND "price" > 0 AND "charge" >= 0 AND "charge_seller" = 0)
ddl.name: entity_trustap_transactions_active_graph_check

ddl.value: "status" <> 'pending' OR ("shipping_quote_id" IS NOT NULL AND "shipping_price" IS NOT NULL AND "shipping_price" > 0)
ddl.name: orders_proposals_pending_quote_check

ddl.value:
"payment_creation_state" = 'reconciliation_required' OR (
				"item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "buyer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "seller_id" IS NOT NULL
				AND "buyer_address" IS NOT NULL AND "seller_address" IS NOT NULL
				AND "payment_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL
				AND (("payment_creation_state" = 'created' AND "payment_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL)
					OR ("payment_creation_state" IN ('preparing', 'creating') AND "payment_transaction_id" IS NULL))
			)
ddl.name: orders_operational_graph_check

ddl.value:
("state" = 'pending' AND "lease_token" IS NULL AND "lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "sent_at" IS NULL)
				OR ("state" = 'sending' AND "lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "last_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL AND "lease_expires_at" > "last_attempt_at" AND "sent_at" IS NULL)
				OR ("state" = 'sent' AND "lease_token" IS NULL AND "lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "sent_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: payment_invitation_outbox_lease_check

ddl.value:
"state" <> 'purchased' OR (
				"provider_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL
				AND "label_url" IS NOT NULL
				AND "provider_status" IS NOT NULL
				AND "provider_status" = 'SUCCESS'
			)
ddl.name: shipping_label_purchases_purchased_graph_check

ddl.value:
(
				"provider_transaction_id" IS NULL
				AND "label_url" IS NULL
				AND "provider_status" IS NULL
				AND "tracking_number" IS NULL
				AND "tracking_url" IS NULL
			) OR (
				"provider_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL
				AND "label_url" IS NOT NULL
				AND "provider_status" IS NOT NULL
				AND "provider_status" = 'SUCCESS'
			)
ddl.name: shipping_label_purchases_provider_evidence_check
